subject.value: Exports timing out since this morning
Scheduled sync has not run for two days

detail.value: Nightly exports have been timing out since about 06:00. Retrying by hand works roughly one time in three.
The dashboard returns a 503 for about one request in five. It clears on reload, so the data seems to be there.
The scheduled sync has not produced a run since Tuesday and downstream reporting is now two days stale for every team that reads it.

closing.value: Is there a known issue, or should we look at our own side?
This is the third outage this quarter and we are reviewing whether to renew.
Our agreement puts a four-hour restoration target on this and we are past it.
